legs.instruction: Board a Kaali Peeli Taxi / App Cab from Mumbai Airport (T2) to Gateway of India
legs.guidanceTip: At Airport T2, use the prepaid taxi counter on Level P4 or book via Uber/Ola at dedicated pickup zones.

fareDetails.bookingMethod: Kaali Peeli Taxi (₹399) or App Cab (₹573)

routes.title: Fastest: Metro & Suburban Rail
routes.summary: High frequency transit link via CSMIA Terminal 2 Metro & Churchgate

legs.instruction: Walk 296m to CSMIA Terminal 2 Metro station
legs.guidanceTip: Direct underground access to Mumbai Airport Terminal 2 Departures & Arrivals.

legs.instruction: Board Line 3 from CSMIA Terminal 2 Metro towards Churchgate
legs.guidanceTip: Air-conditioned coaches with automated bilingual announcements. Doors close automatically.

legs.instruction: Take a short auto/taxi to Gateway of India
legs.guidanceTip: Exit station and follow navigation to Gateway of India.

routes.title: Comfort / Luggage Friendly
routes.summary: AC Metro + Direct Cabs: Step-free access & minimal carrying of bags

legs.instruction: Short Auto / Cab to CSMIA Terminal 2 Metro station (Luggage friendly)
legs.guidanceTip: Tell the driver to drop you at the main elevator / ramp entrance of the station.
Use the luggage-wide automatic gate. Elevators are located next to the customer service booth.

legs.instruction: Take Taxi / Cab to Gateway of India
legs.guidanceTip: Taxi stand is directly outside Gate 1.
Use designated pedestrian crossings and footpaths.

legs.instruction: Take Second Class Local Train from CSMIA Terminal 2 Metro to Churchgate
legs.guidanceTip: Buy a ₹10 Second Class ticket at ATVM automated machines or using UTS app to skip queues.
Exit station and walk directly towards Gateway of India.
